# Project Brief

Build `context/` from `knowledge/distilled/` using the `knowledge-base` skill.

## Skill Loaded
**Required:** Read `skills/knowledge-base/SKILL.md` and `commands/project-brief.md`.

## Usage
```
/project-brief
/project-brief --refresh
```

## Output
A populated `context/` — overview, domain model, features, screens, business rules,
integrations, open questions, decisions — with provenance on every claim.

## Notes
Two artifacts, deliberately separate. `knowledge/` is the source of record and is never
interpreted; `context/` is the synthesis and is corrected as understanding improves. If
they disagree, the knowledge base wins, because it is what the client actually wrote.
